headline: What Clorox (CLX)'s Softer Earnings Outlook And Bearish Analyst Tone Means For Shareholders
summary: Clorox is facing expectations for a year-over-year earnings and revenue decline for its June 2026 quarter, with analysts forecasting quarterly earnings of US$1.64 per share and revenues of US$1.91 billion ahead of the August 3 earnings call that has now passed. headline: Clorox (CLX) Stock May Be 32% Undervalued Despite Margin Risks
summary: Clorox stock has had a tough run over the last five years, yet both the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and the market multiples now point to the shares trading at a discount to what the fundamentals suggest.
